items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: He's buried in the same graveyard as Joe Avery.

ctx.x: Yes, he is. I've been to his grave. They buried out in Amor, up near Wagamon.

Somewhere. Eddie was a good trombone player. He's buried in the same graveyard as Joe Avery. At that time him and Nora and this other boy, he died, or he must have died with. Now he was a good trombone, Zoo. Zoo? Yeah. Zoo Robertson? Yeah. He was a good trombone player. Who did he work with? He was a Batalier's nephew. Batalier taught him trombone in the beginning. He worked in bands, right, but he played in those cyclic bands until he was a weird familiar up at the time like that. He didn't stay on my own. He…
He's a good player. He had a good sense of humor too. He could play funny stuff. Fast execution here. We've got records with him on it too, if you want to hear them.
